key_conclusions.wll_liberation: FAILED - w_ll controls content fidelity not style transfer
key_conclusions.alpha_optimal: alpha=0.3 is the sweet spot for LL partial stylization
key_conclusions.round4_failed_directions: w_lh/w_hl boost, two_stage, endpoint_high, lr=0.0003 all failed or neutral
key_conclusions.adain_scale_breakthrough: endpoint_adain_scale is powerful style injection lever. Peak average at adain=1.5-1.6. adain=2.0 breaks 0.485 ceiling but CLIP-S drops.
key_conclusions.adain_scale_is_inference_only: endpoint_adain_scale only affects inference, NOT training. All adain sweep checkpoints are IDENTICAL.
key_conclusions.round5_failure: Round 5 architecture liberation ALL 4 directions FAILED. Architecture capacity is NOT the bottleneck.
key_conclusions.round6_failure: Round 6 structural pivot BOTH directions FAILED. DINOv2 CLS NOT sensitive to mid-freq color stats NOR LL channel correlations.
key_conclusions.round7_failure: Round 7 alpha augmentation BOTH directions FAILED. Model insensitive to alpha DISTRIBUTION, only to E[alpha].
key_conclusions.round8_failure: Round 8 HF over-stylization BOTH directions FAILED. beta>1.0 breaks content structure, DINO-S and DINO-C both drop monotonically with increasing beta.
key_conclusions.round8_root_cause: Over-stylization pushes target beyond normal range. DINOv2 CLS sensitive to image quality, distorted images deviate from style features.
key_conclusions.overall_assessment: 10 directions across 4 rounds (architecture, frequency structure, target variation, HF intensity) ALL FAILED. DINO-S 0.4832 ceiling (with adain=1.0) is extremely robust. Only inference-time endpoint_adain_scale can push DINO-S to 0.4859 (adain=2.0) but at CLIP-S cost. Without DINO/CLIP in training loss, DINO-S cannot be directly optimized.
key_conclusions.round9_options: A) Accept 0.485 ceiling, optimize radar chart balance. B) Lift DINO/CLIP ban, add DINOv2 feature loss. C) Try FFT power spectrum loss or VAE Gram matrix loss (last loss-level options without external models).
